description:
PLAN.md cites three different reference points for cookie-cutter:
- Line 49-50: 'Canonical template: ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap/crate-jmap-sharing-server/ — closest single-extension-server analog. MetadataBackend is cookie-cut from SharingBackend'
- Line 54-57: 'The canonical extension-server template is jmap-mail-server per the workspace AGENTS.md ...; jmap-sharing-server is the closest precedent...'
- Line 158: 'All five handler functions live in metadata.rs because the crate has a single JMAP object type. Same shape as jmap-filenode-server.'

The reader is left guessing which is the actual canonical to consult when making a change. Audience: a contributor opening PLAN.md to figure out what 'this is patterned after'.

What would make it clear: pick one canonical (mail-server, per workspace AGENTS.md) and reference it consistently. Footnote the sharing-server / filenode-server precedents as 'closest single-object-family analogs at the time this crate was written, but the canonical to follow for changes is jmap-mail-server'.
title: PLAN.md says 'Cookie-cut from SharingBackend' (line 50) and 'Same shape as jmap-filenode-server' (line 158) — three different canonical references in the same document
